name: MixCN
summary: Browser DJ console with two decks, vinyl scratching, beat-grid analysis, mixer FX and mix recording; fully client-side.
description: A fully client-side DJ app built with Next.js and styled with the default shadcn/ui dark theme plus hand-built audio controls (knobs, faders, jog wheels, VU meters). Two decks with a beat-grid analyzer, SYNC, bar-fraction loops, hot cues, 3-band EQ, filters, beat-synced FX and a crossfader, plus mix recording via MediaRecorder. Tracks (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC) are decoded, analyzed and stored locally in IndexedDB; nothing is uploaded.
contains: two decks with pitch, EQ, loops and 4 hot cues each
vinyl-style scratching via a custom AudioWorklet jog wheel
beat-grid analyzer: precise BPM, beat phase and downbeat detection
SYNC matches tempo and phase-aligns both decks
per-channel 3-band EQ, LP/HP filter and beat-synced FX (echo, reverb, flanger)
track library with key detection, auto-gain and IndexedDB persistence
supports MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC; no backend, no uploads
